description: This PHP source file defines a class 'BlockTokenParser' that extends 'AbstractTokenParser' and is responsible for parsing 'block' tags in Twig templates. It manages the parsing of block sections in templates, including handling nested blocks and syntax errors. The class contains methods for parsing the block, deciding the end of a block, and returning the tag name it handles.

classes.name: BlockTokenParser
classes.description: A Twig token parser that handles 'block' tags in Twig templates, enabling template block sections to be parsed and integrated into the template rendering process.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a 'block' token in a Twig template, creating a BlockNode or PrintNode based on the template syntax, and manages scope and block stack.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates the end of a block by testing for 'endblock'.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this parser, which is 'block'.
